scope: 36 independent native single-hit probes: intact full Protection IV netherite, 20 maximum HP, Brand0-V, opening/shield-smash melee component/ultimate. Fresh and native enchanted-golden-apple effect snapshots are separate. Apple effects come from ItemStack.finishUsingItem; the snapshot does not simulate the 32-tick eating interval. No player/world ticks occur between applying pre-hit effects and the native hit, so regeneration/fire damage are excluded. Each probe resets its own fixture only before combat. Native armor/toughness modifiers and post-hit Brand application, where the native recipe applies it, remain active. Shield-smash tests its exact frame34 AreaAttack component; the separate wave from that AI frame is excluded, not counted as covered. This is staged native-method evidence, not continuous-fight victory evidence.
expectations: Approved independent BalanceExpectations targets plus the vanilla armor, Protection IV and Resistance I equations. Production evaluation/raw conversion APIs are not used to manufacture expected values. Reference caps are converted with branded diamond defenses, then actual netherite defenses and native effects are applied.
